purpose: Teach: 公用/専売/敬称/埋め立て/買い取り/廉価/覚書/即日

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、公用車の購入計画を見直せ
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Each syllable lands. No warmth—pure directive. Slight pause after the opening, letting weight settle before moving on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域専売の権利を取得しました
lines.en: Understood. We've secured exclusive regional distribution rights.
lines.style: Measured, professional confirmation. Steady delivery without rushing. Slight emphasis on the achievement—not boasting, just completing the report clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社外文書でも敬称を統一しろ
lines.en: Standardize honorific usage in all external documents.
lines.style: Curt, precise instruction. Quick tempo. No room for interpretation. The tone of someone who expects competence, not explanation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海岸の埋め立て事業に関心がございます
lines.en: Understood. We're particularly interested in the coastal reclamation project opportunity.
lines.style: Careful, almost tentative. A beat before the substantive update. Respectful pacing—offering information without presuming priority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様の店舗買い取り提案を検討しろ
lines.en: Consider a buyout proposal for our key client's retail locations.
lines.style: Terse, businesslike. Delivery matches the brevity. A small emphasis on 'key client'—signaling importance without elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。廉価モデルの商品を企画中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently developing a budget-friendly product line.
lines.style: Straightforward update. Calm, even pacing. Touch of quiet confidence—this is progress worth noting, delivered without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お取引先との覚書を交わせ
lines.en: Draw up a memorandum of understanding with our trading partners.
lines.style: Direct, formal. Each word carries equal weight. No inflection—the instruction itself is what matters. Executed tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のご要望に即日でご対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to client requests same-day, without exception.
lines.style: Firm commitment delivered evenly. A quiet emphasis on 'same-day'—showing he's internalized the standard. Concluding tone: door closing on discussion.
